function v7LoadImage(src) {
  const img = new Image();
  img.decoding = 'async';
  img.src = src;
  return img;
}
V7.assets.atlas = v7LoadImage("data:image/png;base64,");

function v7Room() { return V7.rooms[currentRoom] || V7.rooms[0]; }
function v7StripStyle(arr) { return arr.map(o => ({x:o.x,y:o.y,width:o.width,height:o.height})); }

function v7AnchorCandidate() {
  const origin = getTongueOrigin();
  let best=null, score=Infinity;
  for (const a of v7Room().anchors) {
    const d=distance(origin.x,origin.y,a.x,a.y);
    if (d>a.grabRange) continue;
    if (!tongueLineClearToPoint(a.x,a.y)) continue;
    const dir=a.x>=origin.x?1:-1;
    if (dir!==mac.facing && d>185) continue;
    const s=d+(a.y<origin.y?-35:0);
    if (s<score) { best=a; score=s; }
  }
  return best;
}

canGrabPoint = function() {
  if (grapple.active) return true;
  const a=v7AnchorCandidate();
  if (!a) return false;
  grapplePoint.x=a.x; grapplePoint.y=a.y; grapplePoint.grabRange=a.grabRange; grapplePoint.radius=12;
  return true;
};

rebuildSolids = function() {
  solids.length=0;
  const room=v7Room();
  solids.push(...room.floors,...platforms,...walls);
  if (currentRoom===0 && !mac.waterPower) solids.push(V7.waterSeal);
  if (currentRoom===1 && !mac.windPower) solids.push(V7.windSeal);
  if (boss.active && boss.alive) solids.push(bossGate);
};

function v7MakeEnemy(room,type,x,patrolMin,patrolMax,surfaceY,opts={}) {
  const profile={
    caranguejo:{w:48,h:38,hp:80,patrol:68,chase:120,damage:9},
    cururu:{w:56,h:52,hp:135,patrol:40,chase:80,damage:15},
    perereca:{w:46,h:48,hp:95,patrol:54,chase:104,damage:11}
  }[type];
  return {
    room,type,spawnX:x,x,y:surfaceY-profile.h,width:profile.w,height:profile.h,
    surfaceY,maxHp:profile.hp,hp:profile.hp,alive:true,dying:false,deathTimer:0,
    patrolMin,patrolMax,patrolSpeed:opts.patrolSpeed||profile.patrol,chaseSpeed:opts.chaseSpeed||profile.chase,
    detectionRange:opts.detectionRange||270,direction:opts.direction||1,damage:opts.damage||profile.damage,
    attackCooldown:.85,attackCooldownTimer:0,hurtTimer:0,hurtDuration:.12,animTime:0,state:'idle',stateTimer:0
  };
}

const mangueEnemies = [
  v7MakeEnemy(0,'caranguejo',520,430,700,1500),
  v7MakeEnemy(0,'perereca',1510,1480,1640,885,{detectionRange:210}),
  v7MakeEnemy(0,'cururu',1820,1740,1950,1175),
  v7MakeEnemy(0,'caranguejo',2320,2270,2400,1500),
  v7MakeEnemy(0,'perereca',2860,2790,2960,1090,{detectionRange:220}),
  v7MakeEnemy(0,'cururu',3290,3200,3410,650,{detectionRange:200}),
  v7MakeEnemy(0,'caranguejo',4320,4200,4470,1500),
  v7MakeEnemy(1,'caranguejo',380,280,600,1500),
  v7MakeEnemy(1,'perereca',1550,1480,1640,1260,{detectionRange:220}),
  v7MakeEnemy(1,'cururu',1980,1910,2110,770,{detectionRange:200}),
  v7MakeEnemy(1,'caranguejo',2910,2820,3060,1500),
  v7MakeEnemy(1,'perereca',3400,3330,3520,810,{detectionRange:215})
];

function getExtraEnemies(){ return mangueEnemies.filter(e=>e.room===currentRoom); }
function v7ResetEnemies(room){
  for(const e of mangueEnemies){
    if(e.room!==room) continue;
    e.x=e.spawnX;e.y=e.surfaceY-e.height;e.hp=e.maxHp;e.alive=true;e.dying=false;e.deathTimer=0;e.hurtTimer=0;e.attackCooldownTimer=0;e.animTime=0;e.state='idle';
  }
}

function v7DamageEnemy(e,amount){
  if(!e||!e.alive)return;
  e.hp-=amount;e.hurtTimer=e.hurtDuration;e.state='hit';e.stateTimer=.14;
  if(e.hp<=0){e.hp=0;e.alive=false;e.dying=true;e.deathTimer=.6;e.state='death';}
}
function v7HitExtra(hitbox,amount){
  if(!hitbox)return false;
  for(const e of getExtraEnemies()){
    if(!e.alive)continue;
    if(rectsOverlap(hitbox,{x:e.x,y:e.y,width:e.width,height:e.height})){v7DamageEnemy(e,amount);return true;}
  }
  return false;
}

function v7UpdateEnemy(e,dt){
  e.animTime+=dt;
  if(e.dying){e.deathTimer-=dt;if(e.deathTimer<=0)e.dying=false;return;}
  if(!e.alive)return;
  if(e.hurtTimer>0)e.hurtTimer-=dt;
  if(e.attackCooldownTimer>0)e.attackCooldownTimer-=dt;
  if(e.stateTimer>0)e.stateTimer-=dt;

  const ec=e.x+e.width/2, mc=mac.x+mac.width/2;
  const dx=Math.abs(mc-ec),dy=Math.abs((mac.y+mac.height/2)-(e.y+e.height/2));
  let speed=e.patrolSpeed;
  if(!mac.dead&&dx<=e.detectionRange&&dy<120){e.direction=mc<ec?-1:1;speed=e.chaseSpeed;e.state='walk';}
  else {if(e.x<=e.patrolMin)e.direction=1;if(e.x+e.width>=e.patrolMax)e.direction=-1;e.state='walk';}
  if(e.hurtTimer>0)e.state='hit';

  e.x+=e.direction*speed*dt;
  e.x=Math.max(e.patrolMin,Math.min(e.x,e.patrolMax-e.width));
  e.y=e.surfaceY-e.height-(e.type==='perereca'?Math.max(0,Math.sin(e.animTime*4))*5:0);

  if(!mac.dead&&rectsOverlap({x:e.x,y:e.y,width:e.width,height:e.height},getMacHitbox())&&e.attackCooldownTimer<=0){
    damageMac(e.damage,e.x+e.width/2);e.attackCooldownTimer=e.attackCooldown;e.state='attack';e.stateTimer=.28;
  }
}

updateEnemy=function(dt){
  enemy.alive=false;
  for(const e of getExtraEnemies())v7UpdateEnemy(e,dt);
};

function v7Combat(){
  if(tongue.active&&!grapple.active&&!tongue.didHitEnemy&&v7HitExtra(getTongueHitbox(),15))tongue.didHitEnemy=true;
  if(normalAttack.active&&normalAttack.hitboxActive&&!normalAttack.didHitEnemy&&v7HitExtra(getNormalAttackHitbox(),25))normalAttack.didHitEnemy=true;
  for(let i=waterShots.length-1;i>=0;i--){const s=waterShots[i];if(v7HitExtra({x:s.x-s.radius,y:s.y-s.radius,width:s.radius*2,height:s.radius*2},20))waterShots.splice(i,1);}
  if(waterBurst.active&&!waterBurst.didHitEnemy&&v7HitExtra(getWaterBurstHitbox(),35))waterBurst.didHitEnemy=true;
  if(waterUltimate.active&&!waterUltimate.didHitEnemy&&v7HitExtra({x:waterUltimate.waveX,y:ground.y-waterUltimate.waveHeight,width:waterUltimate.waveWidth,height:waterUltimate.waveHeight},60))waterUltimate.didHitEnemy=true;
  for(let i=windBlades.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=windBlades[i];if(v7HitExtra({x:b.x,y:b.y,width:b.width,height:b.height},20))windBlades.splice(i,1);}
  if(windGust.active&&!windGust.didHitEnemy&&v7HitExtra(getWindGustHitbox(),35))windGust.didHitEnemy=true;
  if(windUltimate.active&&windUltimate.timer>=windUltimate.spawnDelay&&!windUltimate.didHitEnemy&&v7HitExtra({x:windUltimate.x,y:ground.y-windUltimate.height,width:windUltimate.width,height:windUltimate.height},70))windUltimate.didHitEnemy=true;
}

function v7ApplyRoom(index){
  const room=V7.rooms[index];
  setRoomGeometry(v7StripStyle(room.platforms),v7StripStyle(room.walls));
  ground.y=1500;ground.height=WORLD_HEIGHT-ground.y;ground.width=WORLD_WIDTH;
  const a=room.anchors[0];grapplePoint.x=a.x;grapplePoint.y=a.y;grapplePoint.grabRange=a.grabRange;

  if(index===0){
    waterFly.baseX=3470;waterFly.x=3470;waterFly.baseY=430;waterFly.y=430;waterFly.challengeTime=0;waterFly.alive=!waterFly.collected;windFly.alive=false;
  }else{
    waterFly.alive=false;windFly.baseX=2390;windFly.x=2390;windFly.baseY=410;windFly.y=410;windFly.challengeTime=0;windFly.alive=!windFly.collected;
    bossGate.x=3820;bossGate.y=1160;bossGate.width=54;bossGate.height=340;boss.x=4370;boss.y=ground.y-boss.height;boss.arenaLeft=3900;boss.arenaRight=4770;
  }
  v7ResetEnemies(index);rebuildSolids();V7.roomTitleTimer=2.2;
}

const __v7BaseLoadRoom=loadRoom;
loadRoom=function(index,entrySide='left'){
  __v7BaseLoadRoom(index,entrySide);v7ApplyRoom(index);
  mac.height=mac.normalHeight;mac.vx=0;mac.vy=0;mac.grounded=true;
  mac.x=entrySide==='right'?WORLD_WIDTH-160:120;mac.y=ground.y-mac.height;resolveMacOverlaps();snapCameraToMac();roomTransitionCooldown=.45;
};
v7ApplyRoom(0);mac.y=ground.y-mac.height;

updateRoomTransition=function(dt){
  if(roomTransitionCooldown>0){roomTransitionCooldown-=dt;return;}
  if(currentRoom===0&&mac.x>=WORLD_WIDTH-mac.width-2){
    if(!mac.waterPower){mac.x=WORLD_WIDTH-mac.width-90;mac.vx=-120;V7.gateMessageTimer=1.8;return;}loadRoom(1,'left');return;
  }
  if(currentRoom===1&&mac.x<=2){loadRoom(0,'right');return;}
};

const __v7WaterFly=updateWaterFly;
updateWaterFly=function(dt){
  if(currentRoom!==0||!waterFly.alive){__v7WaterFly(dt);return;}
  waterFly.animTime=(waterFly.animTime||0)+dt;waterFly.challengeTime=(waterFly.challengeTime||0)+dt;const t=waterFly.challengeTime;
  waterFly.x=waterFly.baseX+Math.sin(t*1.7)*74;waterFly.y=waterFly.baseY+Math.sin(t*3.2)*25+Math.cos(t*1.1)*9;
};
const __v7WindFly=updateWindFly;
updateWindFly=function(dt){
  if(currentRoom!==1||!windFly.alive){__v7WindFly(dt);return;}
  windFly.animTime=(windFly.animTime||0)+dt;windFly.challengeTime=(windFly.challengeTime||0)+dt;const t=windFly.challengeTime;
  windFly.x=windFly.baseX+Math.sin(t*1.45)*58;windFly.y=windFly.baseY+Math.cos(t*2.8)*24;
};

const __v7Update=update;
update=function(dt){
  __v7Update(dt);v7Combat();if(V7.roomTitleTimer>0)V7.roomTitleTimer-=dt;if(V7.gateMessageTimer>0)V7.gateMessageTimer-=dt;
  if(currentRoom===0&&mac.waterPower&&solids.includes(V7.waterSeal))rebuildSolids();
  if(currentRoom===1&&mac.windPower&&solids.includes(V7.windSeal))rebuildSolids();
  if(!mac.dead&&mac.y>WORLD_HEIGHT+30)killMac();
};

// ---------- TILE / SPRITE DRAWING ----------
function v7Ready(img){return img&&img.complete&&img.naturalWidth>0;}
function v7Tile(sx,sy,sw,sh,dx,dy,dw=sw,dh=sh){if(v7Ready(V7.assets.atlas))ctx.drawImage(V7.assets.atlas,sx,sy,sw,sh,Math.round(dx),Math.round(dy),dw,dh);}
function v7RepeatTile(sx,sy,rect){
  for(let y=rect.y;y<rect.y+rect.height;y+=32)for(let x=rect.x;x<rect.x+rect.width;x+=32){const w=Math.min(32,rect.x+rect.width-x),h=Math.min(32,rect.y+rect.height-y);if(v7Ready(V7.assets.atlas))ctx.drawImage(V7.assets.atlas,sx,sy,w,h,Math.round(x),Math.round(y),w,h);}
}
function v7PlatformStyle(rect){const p=v7Room().platforms.find(q=>q.x===rect.x&&q.y===rect.y&&q.width===rect.width);return p?.style||'stone';}

function v7DrawPlatform(rect,style){
  if(style==='wood'){v7RepeatTile(64,32,rect);return;}
  if(style==='root'){for(let x=rect.x;x<rect.x+rect.width;x+=32)v7Tile(128,64,32,32,x,rect.y-6,32,32);return;}
  const src=style==='azulejo'||style==='shrine'?[0,32]:[0,0];v7RepeatTile(src[0],src[1],rect);
  if(style==='broken')v7Tile(96,0,32,32,rect.x+rect.width-32,rect.y,32,32);
  if(style==='shrine'){for(let x=rect.x+24;x<rect.x+rect.width-24;x+=48)v7Tile(240,96,32,64,x,rect.y-64,32,64);}
}
function v7DrawFloor(f){v7RepeatTile(32,0,f);for(let x=f.x;x<f.x+f.width;x+=32)v7Tile(0,0,32,32,x,f.y-22,32,32);}
function v7DrawPit(p){for(let y=ground.y;y<WORLD_HEIGHT;y+=32)for(let x=p.x;x<p.x+p.width;x+=32)v7Tile(y===ground.y?0:32,64,32,32,x,y,32,32);}
function v7DrawWall(w){v7RepeatTile(32,32,w);for(let y=w.y;y<w.y+w.height;y+=96)v7Tile(240,96,32,64,w.x+(w.width-32)/2,y+12,32,64);}

drawWorldGeometry=function(){
  const room=v7Room();for(const f of room.floors)v7DrawFloor(f);for(const p of room.pits)v7DrawPit(p);for(const p of platforms)v7DrawPlatform(p,v7PlatformStyle(p));for(const w of walls)v7DrawWall(w);
  if(currentRoom===0&&!mac.waterPower)v7Tile(128,96,64,96,V7.waterSeal.x-5,V7.waterSeal.y,64,V7.waterSeal.height);
  if(currentRoom===1&&!mac.windPower)v7Tile(128,96,64,96,V7.windSeal.x-5,V7.windSeal.y,64,V7.windSeal.height);
  if(DEBUG_HITBOX){ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle='white';for(const s of solids)ctx.strokeRect(s.x,s.y,s.width,s.height);ctx.restore();}
};

function v7DrawBackgroundLayer(sx,sy,sw,sh,parallax,y,alpha=1){
  const img=V7.assets.atlas;if(!v7Ready(img))return;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;const off=-((camera.x*parallax)%sw);for(let x=off-sw;x<WIDTH+sw;x+=sw)ctx.drawImage(img,sx,sy,sw,sh,Math.round(x),y,sw,sh);ctx.restore();
}
drawMangroveBackground=function(){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,HEIGHT);g.addColorStop(0,currentRoom===0?'#86bfd2':'#6f9aa4');g.addColorStop(.5,currentRoom===0?'#d7e2c7':'#a9bba2');g.addColorStop(1,currentRoom===0?'#789269':'#526c59');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,WIDTH,HEIGHT);
  v7DrawBackgroundLayer(0,512,1024,512,.05,30,.88);v7DrawBackgroundLayer(1024,512,1024,512,.15,120,.86);
  const haze=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,HEIGHT*.42,0,HEIGHT*.78);haze.addColorStop(0,'rgba(220,235,210,0)');haze.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(220,235,210,.10)');haze.addColorStop(1,'rgba(220,235,210,0)');ctx.fillStyle=haze;ctx.fillRect(0,HEIGHT*.4,WIDTH,HEIGHT*.4);
};

function v7DrawAnchor(a,reachable){
  if(a.kind==='chain'){for(let y=a.y-64;y<a.y-4;y+=16)v7Tile(208,96,32,48,a.x-16,y,32,32);}else{for(let y=a.y-64;y<a.y;y+=32)v7Tile(a.kind==='vine'?96:64,64,32,32,a.x-16,y,32,32);}
  if(reachable){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.25;ctx.fillStyle='#dff0a2';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(a.x,a.y,22+Math.sin(performance.now()*.008)*3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();}
}
drawGrapplePoint=function(){const o=getTongueOrigin();for(const a of v7Room().anchors){const d=distance(o.x,o.y,a.x,a.y),dir=a.x>=o.x?1:-1;v7DrawAnchor(a,!grapple.active&&d<=a.grabRange&&(dir===mac.facing||d<=185)&&tongueLineClearToPoint(a.x,a.y));}};

function v7DrawProps(){
  const room=currentRoom;
  if(room===0){
    // igreja/entrada + árvore colossal + estátua do santuário + aqueduto
    v7Tile(0,192,96,96,120,1310,144,144);v7Tile(288,96,96,128,2520,760,300,560);v7Tile(192,192,64,96,3405,430,96,144);
    for(let x=4150;x<4720;x+=90)v7Tile(96,192,96,96,x,1110,96,110);
    for(const [x,y] of [[400,1385],[1550,1270],[2240,1015],[3370,490],[3540,490],[4400,1160]])v7Tile(208,96,32,48,x-16,y-24,32,48);
    for(const [x,y] of [[360,1400],[620,1300],[1670,745],[2960,1050],[3250,620],[3710,940],[4500,1040]])v7Tile(32,96,32,32,x,y,42,42);
  }else{
    for(let y=450;y<1400;y+=118){v7Tile(96,192,96,96,1180,y,96,110);v7Tile(96,192,96,96,2230,y,96,110);}
    v7Tile(192,192,64,96,2320,385,96,144);
    for(const [x,y] of [[350,1385],[1540,1205],[1860,875],[2210,560],[2420,455],[3060,1200],[3490,780],[4010,1380],[4550,1380]])v7Tile(208,96,32,48,x-16,y-24,32,48);
  }
}

drawMangroveWorldDecor=function(){v7DrawProps();};

function v7EnemyFrameInfo(e){
  const states={idle:[0,4],walk:[4,6],attack:[10,5],hit:[15,2],death:[17,6]};const [start,count]=states[e.dying?'death':(e.hurtTimer>0?'hit':e.state)]||states.walk;const fps=e.state==='attack'?14:9;const idx=start+(Math.floor(e.animTime*fps)%count);return idx;
}
function v7EnemyRow(type){return type==='caranguejo'?0:(type==='cururu'?1:2);}
function v7DrawEnemy(e){
  if(!e.alive&&!e.dying)return;if(!v7Ready(V7.assets.atlas))return;const f=v7EnemyFrameInfo(e),row=v7EnemyRow(e.type),img=V7.assets.atlas;ctx.save();if(e.direction<0){ctx.translate(Math.round(e.x+e.width),0);ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.drawImage(img,512+f*64,row*64,64,64,0,Math.round(e.y-10),64,64);}else ctx.drawImage(img,512+f*64,row*64,64,64,Math.round(e.x-8),Math.round(e.y-10),64,64);ctx.restore();
  if(e.alive){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(20,30,23,.72)';ctx.fillRect(e.x,e.y-8,e.width,4);ctx.fillStyle=e.type==='caranguejo'?'#c96447':(e.type==='cururu'?'#b8a35b':'#6fa058');ctx.fillRect(e.x,e.y-8,e.width*Math.max(0,e.hp/e.maxHp),4);}
}
drawEnemy=function(){for(const e of getExtraEnemies())v7DrawEnemy(e);};

function v7DrawFly(fly,row){if(!fly.alive||!v7Ready(V7.assets.atlas))return;const frame=Math.floor((fly.animTime||0)*12)%8,img=V7.assets.atlas;ctx.save();const glow=ctx.createRadialGradient(fly.x,fly.y,2,fly.x,fly.y,36);glow.addColorStop(0,row===0?'rgba(70,201,244,.42)':'rgba(240,244,255,.35)');glow.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');ctx.fillStyle=glow;ctx.fillRect(fly.x-40,fly.y-40,80,80);ctx.drawImage(img,512+frame*32,192+row*32,32,32,Math.round(fly.x-16),Math.round(fly.y-16),32,32);for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const a=(fly.animTime||0)*1.5+i*1.26;ctx.fillStyle=row===0?'rgba(114,221,255,.55)':'rgba(245,247,255,.45)';ctx.fillRect(Math.round(fly.x+Math.cos(a)*26),Math.round(fly.y+Math.sin(a*1.3)*18),2,2);}ctx.restore();}
drawWaterFly=function(){v7DrawFly(waterFly,0);};drawWindFly=function(){v7DrawFly(windFly,1);};

function v7DrawLocalizedLighting(){
  const room=v7Room();ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';for(const [x,y] of room.lights){const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,4,x,y,90);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,205,110,.24)');g.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,182,70,.10)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,182,70,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(x-100,y-100,200,200);}ctx.restore();
}
function v7DrawForeground(){const img=V7.assets.atlas;if(!v7Ready(img))return;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.82;const sw=1024,sh=512,off=-((camera.x*.035)%sw);for(let x=off-sw;x<WIDTH+sw;x+=sw)ctx.drawImage(img,0,1024,sw,sh,x,HEIGHT-sh,sw,sh);ctx.restore();}

const __v7CheckpointDraw=drawCheckpoint;
drawCheckpoint=function(){const cp=getCheckpointForCurrentRoom();if(!cp)return;v7Tile(64,96,64,64,cp.x-18,cp.y-10,64,64);};
drawRoomExit=function(){const x=currentRoom===0?WORLD_WIDTH-58:0;v7Tile(128,96,64,96,x,ground.y-138,64,138);};

drawBossGate=function(){if(!boss.active||!boss.alive)return;for(let y=bossGate.y;y<bossGate.y+bossGate.height;y+=64)v7Tile(128,96,64,96,bossGate.x-5,y,64,70);};

function v7DrawMiniMap(){
  const x=WIDTH-214,y=16,w=194,h=92;ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(13,24,20,.84)';ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h);ctx.strokeStyle='#72806b';ctx.strokeRect(x+.5,y+.5,w-1,h-1);
  const room=currentRoom;ctx.strokeStyle='#8fa68d';ctx.lineWidth=5;const ox=x+14,oy=y+18;
  if(room===0){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(ox,oy+48);ctx.lineTo(ox+42,oy+48);ctx.lineTo(ox+62,oy+30);ctx.lineTo(ox+90,oy+30);ctx.lineTo(ox+112,oy+8);ctx.lineTo(ox+138,oy+8);ctx.lineTo(ox+162,oy+44);ctx.stroke();}
  else{ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(ox,oy+50);ctx.lineTo(ox+38,oy+50);ctx.lineTo(ox+58,oy+22);ctx.lineTo(ox+92,oy+6);ctx.lineTo(ox+118,oy+44);ctx.lineTo(ox+162,oy+44);ctx.stroke();}
  ctx.fillStyle='#f2df94';ctx.fillRect(ox+(mac.x/WORLD_WIDTH)*160,oy+42-(mac.y/ground.y)*30,5,5);ctx.restore();
}
const __v7HUD=drawHUD;
drawHUD=function(){__v7HUD();v7DrawMiniMap();if(V7.roomTitleTimer>0){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,V7.roomTitleTimer);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,20,16,.65)';ctx.fillRect(WIDTH/2-170,70,340,44);ctx.fillStyle='#e8ead6';ctx.font='bold 18px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(v7Room().name,WIDTH/2,82);ctx.restore();}if(V7.gateMessageTimer>0){ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,20,16,.82)';ctx.fillRect(WIDTH/2-175,124,350,34);ctx.fillStyle='#d8e7d0';ctx.font='14px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('O selo só reage ao poder da Água.',WIDTH/2,133);ctx.restore();}};

draw=function(){
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;ctx.clearRect(0,0,WIDTH,HEIGHT);drawMangroveBackground();ctx.save();ctx.translate(-Math.round(camera.x),-Math.round(camera.y));drawMangroveWorldDecor();drawWorldGeometry();drawBossGate();drawRoomExit();drawCheckpoint();drawGrapplePoint();drawWaterFly();drawWindFly();drawGrappleRope();drawTongue();drawNormalAttack();drawWaterShots();drawWaterBurst();drawWaterUltimate();drawWindBlades();drawWindGust();drawWindUltimate();drawEnemy();drawBoss();drawLocalizedLighting();drawMacGroundShadow();if(!mac.dead){const blink=mac.invulnerableTimer>0&&Math.floor(mac.invulnerableTimer*18)%2===0;if(!blink)drawMacSprite();drawMacHitbox();}drawTongueHitbox();ctx.restore();v7DrawForeground();drawHUD();};
